system.description:
A handheld scanner that picks up energy emissions, movement and biological life signs. With it the user makes Tech-Use Tests to notice things human senses miss, such as invisible gases, bio-signs nearby or background radiation.

Its normal range is 50 m; walls thicker than half a meter and some shielding materials block the scan.
system.effectText: Scanner for energy, motion and life signs via Tech-Use; 50 m range, blocked by thick walls or shielding.
